description.value: Q Burger is an award-winning burger restaurant in the heart of Qualicum Beach, specializing in hand-smashed beef burgers built from locally sourced ingredients alongside creative items like the Q-BOOM!! and the baked Royal Q-Burgeritto. The menu extends well beyond beef, with fresh local halibut fish and chips, plant-based patties, and chicken options, making it a versatile stop for mixed groups. The restaurant partners with Vancouver Island breweries to offer local craft beer, rounding out a 'big city flavour in a boutique town' experience.

address.value: 109 Second Avenue West, Qualicum Beach, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Q Burger as an active, award-winning burger restaurant at 109 West 2nd Avenue in Qualicum Beach with phone (250) 898-3450 matching the OSM record. The menu page explicitly lists multiple plant-based patty options (Broc of Ages, Quinoa Crunch, Krispy Fried Tofu), confirming vegetarian/vegan availability. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Minor street name format discrepancy: OSM uses '109 Second Avenue West' while website uses '109 West 2nd Avenue' — functionally the same address, no action required.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and a broad menu well-suited to hungry touring cyclists passing through Qualicum Beach.
